result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations with theta series whose exponent is a quadratic form in integer variables subject to congruences mod ρ, the transformation of theta functions under multiplication of arguments by powers of ρ and α, logarithmic integrals of theta functions, and a quotient of products of theta functions with characteristic-like shifts f.

methods.what: Theta series with quadratic exponent over integers restricted by congruences mod ρ, rewritten as a sum over all integers
Invariance of theta function under multiplying arguments by α and under shifts by multiples of πi
Determining the sum of zeros of a theta function via the integral of its logarithm (Riemann's method for theta zeros)
Quotient of products of Ω-functions by theta functions with shifts ±f
